pr_body:
Fixes: https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/10336

This functionality already exists for `release download`. It was initally added in the same PR
https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/6053 but the changes were overwritten by a further commit.

Makes it possible to skip when the file already exists or overwriting existing files when required.

Before:
```
$ gh run download $latest_run_id --name assets --repo example/code

error downloading assets: error extracting zip archive: 
error extracting "code.zip": open code.zip: file exists
```

After:
```
$ gh run download $latest_run_id --name assets --repo example/code

error downloading assets: error extracting zip archive: 
error extracting "code.zip": open code.zip: already exists ((use `--clobber` to override or `--skip-existing` to skip))

$ gh run download $latest_run_id --name assets --repo example/code --clobber
# File overwritten

$ gh run download $latest_run_id --name assets --repo example/code --skip-existing
# File skipped
```

pr_comments:
Discussing my concerns with the other maintainers last week, we were in favor in holding off on this change at this moment until we can prioritize larger efforts.  As mentioned in the issue, there are larger concerns behind these features as well as the inherent design behind the commands that we'd like to address adding this capability in.

For those reasons, I'm closing this PR.  Thank you sincerely for your time in making `gh` a better place! 🙇

issue_context.title: Add `--skip-existing` and `--clobber` to `run download`
issue_context.body:
# CLI Feedback

This follows on from a previous issue: https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/2598

 Make it possible to use `--clobber` and `--skip-existing`  with `run download`, same as `release download`.


This functionality was added in the same [PR](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/6053) as `release download` but the `run download` commits were overwritten due to [comment](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/6053#pullrequestreview-1093241164)  :
> I reduced the scope of the PR store just address release download since that is what was requested in the original issue.

Raising this as its own issue to gauge interest in adding this functionality.
comments: Thanks for opening up this blast from the past issue, @scottclk! ❤ 😆 I'm going to get caught up on this original issue regarding the recommendation given how long ago this was.

@scottclk : **I'm going to bring this up to Engineering and Product as this issue needs a bit of design time and effort if we want to proceed; the similarities and disparities between `gh run download` and `gh release download` are notable and maybe a larger refactor is necessary.**

Last week, I spent a bit of time trying to reconcile the difference between `gh run download` and `gh release download`.  There are several concerns I'd like to bring up with the team in order for this work to proceed:

1. **Does `gh run download` need to be parallelized?**

   Currently, workflow run artifacts are downloaded serially [here](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/fab84beb900c1789076cd7b538bb05739d41cea6/pkg/cmd/run/download/download.go#L165-L195), which means everything stops whenever any error is encountered.

   In contrast, release assets are downloaded in parallel [here](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/fab84beb900c1789076cd7b538bb05739d41cea6/pkg/cmd/release/download/download.go#L221-L257), which allows as many assets to be downloaded even when an error is encountered but also reduces the time spent downloading.

1. **How does `gh run download` change when a file is skipped?**

   Currently, workflow run artifacts assume a file was downloaded if no error was raised [here](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/fab84beb900c1789076cd7b538bb05739d41cea6/pkg/cmd/run/download/download.go#L190-L194).

   In contrast, release assets downloading raises a specialized error for files skipped [here](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/fab84beb900c1789076cd7b538bb05739d41cea6/pkg/cmd/release/download/download.go#L247-L252).

1. **Should `gh run download` adopt the [same Windows reserved filename safe guard](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/fab84beb900c1789076cd7b538bb05739d41cea6/pkg/cmd/release/download/download.go#L404-L422)**

   Currently, release asset downloading has a [Windows-specific safeguard](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/8517) due to some flaky OS safeguards that I notice is missing in `gh run download`.

   I mention this because it demonstrates we have a widening gap between both commands behaviors and capabilities that might motivate a larger design effort. 🤷

Thanks for taking a closer look at this @andyfeller ! Sounds like there is more discussion required before merging this change. We are currently handling this functionality in a bash script wrapper so its not urgent.
I'll keep an eye on how the discussion goes, but I'll leave it with you for now. Thanks! 👍

review_comments: I'm ruminating on previous discussions regarding [naked boolean parameters](https://oscarforner.com/blog/2020-04-18-no-naked-boolean-parameters/) like `force` and `skip` versus having boolean types that reduce accidental mixing up arguments and improves management.  I'm having difficulty pinpointing where else in the code base we've implemented similar types, so will revisit after finishing the review but wanted to plant that seed.

Comparing this against `gh release download` logic, I'm unsure how similar or different it should be for first pass:

https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/0acd40418a7e32e72f373d8b846a7bfadc110cfb/pkg/cmd/release/download/download.go#L343-L370

Though `platform` is different than `destinationWriter` in `gh release download`, I'm looking at the various clobber and skip tests to see what makes sense for `gh run download` tests.

https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/0acd40418a7e32e72f373d8b846a7bfadc110cfb/pkg/cmd/release/download/download_test.go#L401-L555

Again, still grokking the current code, but the `gh run download` code just assumes that anything other than an error means a file was downloaded.  However, if the user wants to skip previously downloaded files, then I think there is more that has to change here. 🤔

Is there any concerns with bringing this in line with how this is checked in `gh release download`?

https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/0acd40418a7e32e72f373d8b846a7bfadc110cfb/pkg/cmd/release/download/download.go#L85-L87
